US Missile Strike in Iran Causes Civilian Casualties, Report Finds

A new US missile strike in Iran's Lamerd region has reportedly caused significant civilian casualties and destruction. A report indicates the missile, detonating over an athletic center and residential areas, may have killed civilians approximately 50 meters from the blast site. The incident resulted in at least 21 deaths, including seven children. The missile, described as a new US 'precision' weapon, has raised questions about its accuracy.
